memories_scope_check.name: memories_scope_check
memories_scope_check.value: ("memories"."scope"='global' AND "memories"."project_id" IS NULL AND "memories"."agent_id" IS NULL) OR ("memories"."scope"='project' AND "memories"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "memories"."agent_id" IS NULL) OR ("memories"."scope"='agent' AND "memories"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "memories"."agent_id" IS NOT NULL)
